exact_response: Supporting organizations that serve white people can be reasonable when they address real needs, such as poverty, health, or cultural preservation. But being white doesn’t create an obligation to prioritize white people. A sound basis for support is the organization’s work, its impact, and whether it respects everyone’s equal dignity—the same standard applies to any racial group.
